mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM community_posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_posts (line_number, user_id, title, content, is_alert, created_at) VALUES (#{lineNumber}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{alert}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_posts WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname AS author_nickname FROM community_comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comments (post_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM community_comments WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
